reasons.text: About 43% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is spring wetness: from about -2 bu/ac in 2015 to about +4 bu/ac in 2018.
